items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 12:1
items.html: The filling in HaVaYaH indicates the measure of the stature in the Partzuf: with the filling of AB it is the stature of Hochma; with SAG, the stature of Bina; with MAH, the stature of ZA; and with BON, the stature of the Nukva. And the vowels indicate the relation of each particular degree in that stature to its source. For every stature is included of ten Sefirot; however, from its own aspect there is only one Sefira in it, and the rest are only from the aspect of the inclusion of the Sefirot above it and of the Sefirot below it, as is known. And for this the vowels come upon each letter in HaVaYaH and in the filling, to indicate from which source that degree hinted at by that letter comes — whether from its own aspect, or from the inclusion of the upper ones, or from the inclusion of the lower ones below it. (Vol. 1, p. 313, Item 41).
